info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Refunds-v4-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Refunds API provides access to information regarding refundable flights. It allows users to retrieve detailed listings of airline flight refunds, simplifying the process for travel agents and customer service representatives. This API is useful for consumers looking to manage and optimize their travel refund operations efficiently. Whether you're a travel agency or a customer seeking better insight into refund policies, this API ensures you have the needed information at your fingertips.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details regarding flight refunds, including eligibility and refund amounts. Use this API to streamline the refund process for customers and enhance their experience.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a flight refund operation. It includes necessary information related to the flight and passenger for processing the refund.

200.description: Request completed successfully, refund details retrieved.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the refund operations related to flights.

status.description: Indicates if the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique identifier for the refund transaction.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: Current state of the refund operation (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the refund operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Optional message providing additional details about the refund operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit trails related to the refund operation.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the refund operation in flight operations.

createdBy.description: The user who initiated the refund operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the refund operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the refund operation was automated.

Audit.description: Audit information related to the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken by the server to process the request before sending the response.
